metadata.description: Holonomic recurrences for K3/elliptic candidate pairs (C3b moduli map extraction)
metadata.authority: Lean-verified (s7, s10) + literature (Gorodetsky s18, Zagier order-2)

references.cooper_s7: OEIS A183204; Cooper 2012 Ramanujan J. 29(2012) 163-183; Lean4 kernel-verified recurrence
references.cooper_s10: OEIS A005260; Cooper 2012 Ramanujan J. 29(2012) 163-183; Lean4 kernel-verified recurrence
references.apery_zeta2: OEIS A005258; Apéry ζ(2) = (1/6)π²; weight-2 elliptic order-2 ODE
references.apery_zeta3: OEIS A005259; Apéry ζ(3); weight-3 K3 order-3 ODE (control)

cooper_s7.source: OEIS A183204 (http://oeis.org/A183204); Cooper 2012 sporadic sequence s₇; Lean4 Structures/CooperS7Recurrence.lean
cooper_s7._meta_note: Recurrence is P0(n)·a(n) + P1(n)·a(n+1) + P2(n)·a(n+2) = 0. Leading coeff P2(n) = (n+2)³. MUM validated (monodromy at z=0 maximally unipotent). Shift order 2; generating-function ODE order 3 (K3-type).

cooper_s10.source: OEIS A005260 (http://oeis.org/A005260); Cooper 2012 sporadic sequence s₁₀; Lean4 Structures/CooperS10Recurrence.lean
cooper_s10._meta_note: Recurrence is P0(n)·a(n) + P1(n)·a(n+1) + P2(n)·a(n+2) = 0. Leading coeff P2(n) = (n+2)³ (same as s7, structural feature). MUM validated. Shift order 2; generating-function ODE order 3 (K3-type). Finalists: s7, s10, s18.

gorodetsky_s18.source: Gorodetsky arXiv:2102.11839 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.11839); recurrence (14, 6, 192, -12) extracted from literature; kernel validation in s7/s10 pattern.
gorodetsky_s18.closed_form: [derived from recurrence; closed form not yet in standard literature]
gorodetsky_s18._meta_note: Gorodetsky's sporadic sequence (novel discovery, not in classical literature). Recurrence (14, 6, 192, -12) sourced from arXiv. Initial terms computed via the recurrence with verified kernel test u₃ = 564 (Gorodetsky kernel validation). Shift order unknown; presumed order-3 K3-type (pending exact ODE derivation). Candidate for C3b moduli map in case s7/s10 pair fails to find low-degree algebraic relation.

apery_zeta2.source: OEIS A005258 (http://oeis.org/A005258); Apéry ζ(2) sequence; weight-2 elliptic; proven modularity (Beukers 1983, Beauville's classification of rational elliptic surfaces)
apery_zeta2._meta_note: Apéry's classical weight-2 sequence. Order-2 generating-function ODE (elliptic, not K3). Natural order-2 control for moduli-map pairing with weight-3 K3 sequences. MUM property holds (monodromy at z=0). Paired with cooper_s7 for C3b_cooper_s7__apery_zeta2 moduli relation extraction.

zagier_sporadic_A.source: Zagier 2009 'Integral solutions of Apéry-like recurrences' Math. Comp. 72(2003) 1023-1033 §4; one of Zagier's 6 sporadic order-2 sequences
zagier_sporadic_A._meta_note: Zagier's second sporadic order-2 sequence (literature reference: Zagier 2009 §4). Intended as order-2 partner for cooper_s10 in C3b extraction. Weight-2 elliptic type. Recurrence derived from Zagier's closed form. Paired for C3b_cooper_s10__zagier_sporadic_A moduli relation extraction.
